name: Flawed Power Stone
summary: Across the Barrens, flawed stones sit charged with arcane energy on ritual tables. Their makers left them unstable, and they consume their power soon after they are moved.

sections.title: Volatile Craftsmanship
sections.body: Across the Barrens, flawed power stones hold arcane essence in compromised structures. Their makers left them unstable, so they decay into inert matter moments after someone handles them.

sections.title: Self-Consuming Energy
sections.body: A stone starts consuming its power as soon as it leaves the ritual table where it rests. Its energy burns away too quickly for anyone to carry it far.

faq.q: What is a Flawed Power Stone?
faq.answer: The stone holds raw magical power, but its deliberate flaws make it consume itself rapidly once moved.

faq.q: Can the stones be preserved permanently?
faq.answer: No. Once separated from the tables that stabilize them, the stones' magical matrices collapse and their energy quickly runs out.
The orc Ak'Zeloth prepares the stones, and Horde adventurers carry them to the altar of fire on Dreadmist Peak. There, they disrupt the Demon Seed's connection to the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about them?
faq.answer: The Horde uses the stones against the Burning Legion. Ak'Zeloth prepared them for Neeru Fireblade, so carrying one to the altar of fire on Dreadmist Peak can break the Demon Seed's connection to the Legion.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you keep watch over arcane oddities scattered across the Barrens. Rogue sorcery could threaten your supply routes.
